items.title: Parker-Hannifin Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH) raised its fiscal 2027 earnings and sales outlook after reporting record first-quarter revenue, as demand strengthened across its industrial and aerospace markets and the company completed its acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation. Sales rose 18% from a year earlier
